structuredContent.summary_text: Over 214 paired days, each additional busy calendar minute is associated with 0.118 fewer minutes of sleep (95% CI -0.201 to -0.035). For a 120-minute increase above your typical 310 minutes, this predicts -14.16 minutes of sleep.
